item.name: Capybara
item.ability: Boosts seed luck by 1.1x.
item.cardSummary: A cheap starter pet from the Basic Egg. Its seed-luck boost helps early planting while you build toward stronger pets.
item.notes: Common starter. Earnings boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and rises with pet size and level.

item.name: Golden Retriever
item.ability: Applies a Normal Fertilizer to a plant every 15 minutes.
item.cardSummary: An early Basic Egg pet that drops a free Normal Fertilizer on a plant every 15 minutes for a small, steady growth nudge.
item.notes: Common starter. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Elephant
item.ability: Boosts crop yield by 1.2x.
item.cardSummary: A common drop across the early eggs. Its flat 1.2x crop-yield boost makes it a reliable upgrade over the starter pets.
item.notes: Uncommon. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Llama
item.ability: Boosts sprinkler power by 1.2x.
item.cardSummary: An early-egg Uncommon whose 1.2x sprinkler-power boost pairs well with a sprinkler-heavy farm layout.
item.notes: Uncommon. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Crocodile
item.ability: 10% chance to fully grow a random plant every minute.
item.cardSummary: The first pet with an instant-grow effect, with a 10% chance each minute to fully grow a random plant for faster harvest cycles.
item.notes: Rare. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Gorilla
item.ability: Applies a Strong Fertilizer to a random plant every 15 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A Rare egg pet that drops a Strong Fertilizer on a random plant every 15 minutes, an upgrade over the Golden Retriever's Normal Fertilizer.
item.notes: Rare. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Lion
item.ability: 10% chance to apply a Super Fertilizer every 5 minutes.
item.cardSummary: An Epic egg pet whose Super Fertilizer procs give a strong periodic growth push on top of a solid earnings boost.
item.notes: Epic. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Polar Bear
item.ability: 20% chance to fully grow a random plant every 2 minutes.
item.cardSummary: One of the best egg-shop pets for instant growth, with a 20% chance every 2 minutes to fully grow a random plant.
item.notes: Epic. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Gallimimus
item.ability: 25% chance to fully grow a random plant every 2 minutes.
item.cardSummary: The most common Dinosaur Egg pet, with a strong 25% instant-grow chance every 2 minutes that rivals higher-rarity pets.
item.notes: Legendary, Dinosaur Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Mammoth
item.ability: 10% chance to upgrade a plant's mutation every 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: The first pet that can upgrade plant mutations, giving long-term value beyond its flat earnings boost.
item.notes: Legendary. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Captain Puffer
item.ability: Waters 3 random plot plants, advancing each by 1 growth stage every 200 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A bundle pet that auto-advances three random plants by a growth stage every 200 seconds, speeding up harvest pacing.
item.notes: Legendary, Pirate Puddle Bundle (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Bumper Snail
item.ability: Bumps a random plant and instantly sells it with a 5% bonus every 240 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A Carnival Egg pet that auto-sells a random plant with a 5% cash bonus every 240 seconds for hands-off income.
item.notes: Legendary, Carnival Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Hydra
item.ability: 12% chance to upgrade a plant's mutation to a better one every 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A Secret pet from the Epic Egg that can upgrade plant mutations, prized for long-run mutation farming.
item.notes: Secret. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Triceratops
item.ability: Applies a Normal Pet Treat effect to a random pet every 3 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A Dinosaur Egg Secret that buffs your other pets, periodically applying a Normal Pet Treat to a random equipped pet.
item.notes: Secret, Dinosaur Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Spinosaurus
item.ability: Applies a Strong Pet Treat effect to a random pet every 5 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A Dinosaur Egg Secret that supports your pet lineup, applying a Strong Pet Treat to a random pet every 5 minutes.
item.notes: Secret, Dinosaur Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Gummy Gator
item.ability: 20% chance to apply Prismatic Fertilizer every 180 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A bundle Secret with frequent chances to apply Prismatic Fertilizer, one of the strongest fertilizer types in the game.
item.notes: Secret, Gummy Kingdom Bundle (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Prizewheel Peacock
item.ability: Chooses 1 random equipped pet and reduces its next ability cooldown by 30% every 300 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A Carnival Egg Secret that boosts your team by cutting a random pet's next ability cooldown by 30% every 5 minutes.
item.notes: Secret, Carnival Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Jackpot Slime
item.ability: Triggers Jackpot Harvest, making all harvested plants give 2x Cash for 15 seconds every 300 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A Carnival Egg Secret that periodically doubles harvest cash for 15 seconds, rewarding well-timed mass harvests.
item.notes: Secret, Carnival Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Rhino
item.ability: Boosts the growth speed of all plants on a floor by 25% for 60 seconds every 300 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A top-tier Legendary Egg Secret whose floor-wide 25% growth-speed surge and 10x earnings boost make it an endgame egg-shop target.
item.notes: Secret, Legendary Egg. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Twilight Drake
item.ability: Gives 3 random plants +100% crop yield on their next harvest every 220 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A bundle Secret that doubles the next harvest of three random plants every 220 seconds for burst income.
item.notes: Secret, Twilight Bundle (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Red Panda
item.ability: 15% chance to upgrade the level of a random plant every 180 seconds.
item.cardSummary: The Prismatic pull from the Legendary Egg, with a strong earnings boost and a chance to level up plants every 3 minutes.
item.notes: Prismatic, Legendary Egg. Boost shown is the Level 1 baseline and scales with size and level.

item.name: Token Toad
item.ability: 20% chance to apply Prismatic Fertilizer to a random plant every 300 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A Carnival Egg Prismatic that periodically applies the high-end Prismatic Fertilizer to a random plant.
item.notes: Prismatic, Carnival Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Kitsune
item.ability: 15% chance to upgrade a plant's mutation to a better one every 5 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A pack Prismatic focused on mutation farming, with a chance to upgrade a plant's mutation every 5 minutes.
item.notes: Prismatic, Kitsune Pack (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Velociraptor
item.ability: Gives a 5 minute time skip every 600 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A Dinosaur Egg Prismatic that grants a 5-minute time skip every 10 minutes, effectively fast-forwarding plant growth.
item.notes: Prismatic, Dinosaur Egg (limited Robux egg). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Starfall Griffin
item.ability: 15% chance to apply the Starfall mutation to a random plant on the farm.
item.cardSummary: A direct-purchase Divine that can apply the rare Starfall mutation, valued for unlocking a high-tier mutation route.
item.notes: Divine, direct Robux purchase. State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level. Ability chance/interval varies slightly across sources; primary source value used.

item.name: T-Rex
item.ability: Upgrades a plant's mutation every 5 minutes.
item.cardSummary: The rarest Dinosaur Egg pet and one of the strongest in the game, guaranteeing a plant mutation upgrade every 5 minutes.
item.notes: Divine, Dinosaur Egg (limited Robux egg, rarest pull). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost from primary source; other guides list higher size-scaled numbers (up to ~15.5x).

item.name: Disco Dodo
item.ability: 30% chance to apply Prismatic Fertilizer every 180 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A bundle Divine with a high 30% chance to apply Prismatic Fertilizer every 3 minutes for strong, frequent growth boosts.
item.notes: Divine, Disco Bundle (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Fire Loong
item.ability: Doubles the effect of a random active fertilizer for 60 seconds every 240 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A bundle Divine that periodically doubles an active fertilizer's effect, amplifying whatever growth boost is already running.
item.notes: Divine, Dragon Bundle (Robux purchase). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Popcorn Phoenix
item.ability: Applies a Strong Pet Treat effect to a random pet every 191 seconds.
item.cardSummary: An Exotic pack pet that supports your team, applying a Strong Pet Treat to a random pet roughly every 3 minutes.
item.notes: Exotic, Carnival Pack (Robux purchase). Listed only in the primary source among checked guides; treat as single-source. State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost scales with size and level.

item.name: Claw Machine Kraken
item.ability: Provides a 1.5x Seed Luck boost.
item.cardSummary: The Exotic top pull from the Carnival Egg, carrying one of the highest earnings boosts plus a flat 1.5x seed-luck boost.
item.notes: Exotic, Carnival Egg (limited Robux egg, rarest pull). State origin only; do not claim current availability. Baseline boost from primary source; other guides list higher size-scaled numbers.
